It features an NOS Germanium transistor for a vintage fuzz tone. The pedal includes the original input buffer to accommodate various pickups, making it suitable for electric bass. It is also 100% true bypass. The Full Circle has additional features to enhance its versatility and usability. It includes a fuzz control to adjust the intensity and sustain of the fuzz. The original unit had a knob labeled ‘GAIN’, which is essentially the volume control. In this pedal, the volume control is called ‘level’. The Full Circle also has a dry blend, which is crucial for bass players. The dry blend is a cross fader, allowing you to blend between 100% wet and 100% dry, or any combination in between. With the fuzz and blend controls, you can achieve a range of sounds, from subtle fuzz to a powerful, aggressive fuzz that creates a wall of sound. Summary created by AI from the original source.
